newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai '96 foreign tax income $1.15 billion.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai '96 foreign tax income $1.15 billion.

text.p: Foreign and joint venture companies in Shanghai paid a total of 9.56 billion yuan ($1.15 billion) in industry and commerce tax in 1996, the Business News said.
The figure was 1.77 billion yuan, or 22.78 percent, higher than the 1995 figure, the newspaper said.
Of the total, value-added tax and consumption tax accounted for 5.169 billion yuan, up 26.34 percent from 1995, it said.
Personal income tax paid to the Shanghai city government by foreign and joint venture firms in 1996 totalled 1.017 billion yuan, the newspaper said without giving further details.
